note: City park on the Osage River backwaters of upper Truman Lake beside the old powerhouse and dam site, with a clubhouse, shelter house and primitive tent area. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed ($20 W/E, $22 FHU); 52 mapped sites (page: ~48); showers/laundry/dump; open year-round; pay at the office, cash/check, no reservation mention (reservable cleared). Google 4.2/112. Waterfront left not waterfront, flagged as a possible lakeview.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; operator says 'located on the tranquil shores of Truman Lake', so re-audited): the water is the Osage arm at the head of Truman Lake. The main channel (~250 m wide) is ~150 m NW of the nearest loop through solid woods - no view. A backwater cove (two lobes joined under a causeway bridge, roughly 6 ha together; the map labels it COVE with a dock) lies ~45-60 m SW of the western loop's pads across open mowed grass and the primitive tent area, with the loop road between. That could support 'lakeview' for the western loop, but I could not confirm a sightline from the pads (no ground photo; a brushy fringe lines the bank), so per unsure-downgrade it stays not waterfront. AWH call. A Google reviewer mentions 'a beautiful view' without saying of what.
Hookups: water/electric/sewer confirmed by the price page, but no city page states amperage; the stored electric 50 (and the note's '30/50A') rest on note prose. Left as stored (derived) - flag only.
Pin 38.0510,-93.6980 is on Parkview Dr at the park entrance, ~60 m from the office and ~100 m from the loops - fine.
Reviews: Google 4.2 over 112 (no issue). Stored RV Life 3.5 stars - check its review count if a drop rule should apply; not read this pass.
Phone 417-646-8675 (office) matches. Managers also list cells; not added.
